mask_categories.PERSONNAME: Natural-person names, attached titles (Dr./Prof./Herr/Mme/Sig.ra/Sr.), initials, particles (van/von/de/di/da/del/du/le/la/dos), compound/hyphenated and reversed Surname, Given forms; not the salutation itself.
mask_categories.ADDRESS: A person's complete postal routing address as one region, including c/o recipient, street, number, floor/unit, PO box, postcode, city, region and country when present.
mask_categories.USERNAME: Usernames and handles, including the @ sigil.
mask_categories.TELEPHONENUM: Phone numbers, including country code, trunk (0), groups and the whole extension phrase.
mask_categories.PERSONALREF: Customer, patient, case or membership reference numbers tied to a person.

do_not_mask_categories: product, order, invoice and SKU codes with no person link
room numbers with no person link
salutations such as Dear, Sehr geehrte and Bonjour

gold_boundaries.offsets: half-open Python str indices on original unnormalized text
gold_boundaries.include: whole values and internal spaces, separators, initials, particles, attached titles, handle sigils and phone extension phrases
gold_boundaries.exclude: surrounding prose, salutations and sentence punctuation

reserved_v4_details.mixed-language documents: Text in one language with value formats of another country.
reserved_v4_details.OCR-like noise inside values: Line breaks or missing spaces inside values.
